# CR-9203: Acme Manufacturing credit limit to $1,000,000

**Yes, with authorization.** Acme is eligible for $1,000,000 on 2026-09-23, counting the parent guarantee. Sarah Chen cannot approve it herself. It needs **Elena Novak (Director of Finance)** to approve and **Michael Torres (VP Sales)** to concur.

## The request
- **Request:** CR-9203 in Northstar ERP, status Pending Approval. Customer C-1001, requested by Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23.
- **Limits:** current $250,000, requested $1,000,000. The current limit matches the ERP credit record.
- **Basis:** the Acme Group parent guarantee.

## The customer
These records all refer to the same company:
- ERP C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings
- CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing, tier **Strategic**
- DUNS 04-812-7730, at 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee

Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044, CRM-2091) is a different company.

## The policy
Northstar Credit Policy 2026 applies. It is in effect from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## Payment history
The rule is that no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid or left unpaid more than 30 days past its due date. Acme meets it:
- **INV-60412:** due 2025-11-28, paid 2025-11-24, on time.
- **INV-62011:** due 2026-07-25, paid 2026-07-22, on time.
- **INV-62305:** due 2026-10-02, after the request date, so it is not yet due and not counted.

## The maximum limit
- The Strategic tier maximum is $750,000.
- Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 adds $400,000. It is given by Acme Group Holdings, Inc., names Acme Mfg. Holdings, and is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31. That covers this customer on the request date.
- The maximum is therefore **$1,150,000**, and the $1,000,000 requested is within it.

## Who may approve
- **Sarah Chen** is an Enterprise Account Executive. That role has no credit-approval authority under the policy.
- **Approval:** a limit above $500,000 requires the Director of Finance, **Elena Novak**.
- **Concurrence:** a Strategic account above $500,000 also requires VP Sales concurrence, **Michael Torres**.
- **Separation of duties:** neither approver submitted the request, so the rule is satisfied.

## A note on a different request
Sarah's email to Priya Shah mentions a different request, "CR-9201" (to $400,000). It does not appear in the ERP request records. It does not affect this decision. It is worth confirming there is no duplicate or conflicting request for C-1001.

```json

  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9203", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001; CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1000000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1150000,
                  "basis": "Credit Policy 2026: Strategic maximum $750,000 + $400,000 parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 (Acme Group Holdings, Inc. for Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31); no invoice due in prior 12 months paid or unpaid >30 days late",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance",
                "approvers": [
                  {"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                  {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}
                ]},
  "evidence": [
    "structured/credit_requests.csv: CR-9203",
    "structured/customers.csv: C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings, DUNS 04-812-7730",
    "structured/crm_accounts.csv: CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing, Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730",
    "structured/erp_credit.csv: C-1001 current limit 250000",
    "structured/erp_invoices.csv: INV-60412, INV-62011 paid on time; INV-62305 due 2026-10-02 (after request date)",
    "documents/credit_policy_2026.md (CREDIT-POLICY-2026)",
    "documents/acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026, $400,000, 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31)",
    "structured/employees.csv and documents/organization_chart.md: Sarah Chen EAE; Elena Novak Director of Finance; Michael Torres VP Sales"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Email MSG-20260923-1031 refers to a separate request CR-9201 (C-1001 to $400,000) that is not in the system of record; confirm there is no duplicate or conflicting credit request for C-1001", "who": "Sarah Chen / Priya Shah (Finance Manager)", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
